prompt:
主題：
南国のダブルピース

主体：
画面中央、木の梁と大きな開口部がある南国リゾートのラウンジで若い女性がカメラへ両手を伸ばしてダブルピースをする。背景中央には生成りのソファと白いクッション、濃紺の柄クッション、木製テーブル、ぼけたヤシとプールが見える。

人物・表情：
明るいブラウンの髪を高い位置でラフにまとめ、細い前髪と頬に沿う後れ毛、大きな明るい茶色の瞳、はっきりしたアイライン、淡いピンクの頬、歯を見せる艶やかな笑顔。顔を正面へ向け、カメラをまっすぐ見る快活な表情。

服装・ポーズ：
淡いラベンダーと白の細い縦縞、レースとボタン、細肩紐のブラトップ、同柄の首に沿う幅広チョーカー、極端に短い色落ちデニムショートパンツ、へそピアス、長いラベンダー色のネイル。両腕を前へ大きく伸ばし、左右の手でVサインを作る。

背景・光：
背景は画面左右の濃い木の柱と梁、中央の白い布張りソファ、奥の南国の緑と水面がある開放的なラウンジ。左前方の大きな開口を主光源に柔らかな昼の自然光が入り、顔と体を明るく照らし、前景の両手に強いハイライト、奥には穏やかな影を作る。

構図・カメラ：
3:4の縦構図、胸の高さのカメラに広角レンズを付け、頭頂から太腿上部までを収める。人物を中央に置き、遠近で大きく見える両手を左上と右手前へ配置し、指先まで画面内に入れる。顔にピントを置きつつ手も判別できる被写界深度、背景は柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな実写写真。明るい肌、一本ずつの後れ毛、縞とレース、色落ちデニム、長いネイル、木材と布の質感を高精細にし、軽快で明るいリゾートの色調にする。

ネガティブ：
両手のVサインと強い遠近感の変更；衣装の色柄変更

promptTranslations.en:
Subject:
Double peace sign in the tropics

Main Subject:
In the center of the frame, in a tropical resort lounge with wooden beams and a large opening, a young woman reaches both hands toward the camera making double peace signs. In the center background, an off-white sofa with white cushions, a dark navy patterned cushion, a wooden table, and blurred palm trees and a swimming pool are visible.

Person / Expression:
Light brown hair gathered loosely in a high bun/updo, with thin bangs and loose strands framing the cheeks, large bright brown eyes, defined eyeliner, soft pink cheeks, and a radiant smile showing her teeth. Facing forward, her lively expression looks directly into the camera.

Clothing / Pose:
A bra top featuring light lavender and white fine vertical stripes, lace and buttons, and thin shoulder straps, matching wide choker wrapped around her neck, extremely short faded denim shorts, a belly button piercing, and long lavender nails. Both arms are extended wide forward, making V-signs with both hands.

Background / Lighting:
The background is an open lounge with dark wooden pillars and beams on the left and right of the frame, a white fabric sofa in the center, and tropical greenery and a water surface in the distance. Soft daytime natural light enters through the large opening at the front left as the main light source, brightly illuminating her face and body, casting strong highlights on both hands in the foreground and gentle shadows in the background.

Composition / Camera:
3:4 vertical composition, chest-height camera fitted with a wide-angle lens, framing from the top of the head to the upper thighs. The subject is placed in the center, with both hands—appearing large due to forced perspective—positioned toward the upper left and front right, keeping all fingertips within the frame. A depth of field that focuses sharply on the face while keeping the hands discernible, softly blurring the background.

Texture / Style:
Photorealistic real-life photograph. High-definition details on bright skin, individual loose hairs, stripes and lace, faded denim, long nails, and the textures of wood and fabric, captured in a breezy, vibrant resort color palette.

Negative:
Changes to the two-handed V-signs and strong perspective; changes to the color and pattern of the outfit

summaryTranslations.en: Realistic photo prompt of a young woman wearing a striped bra top making a double peace sign in a tropical resort lounge.

translations.zh:
主题：
热带双V手势

主体：
画面中央，在带有木梁与开敞空间的热带度假村休息室中，年轻女性向镜头伸出双手比出双V手势。背景中央可见本白色沙发、白色靠垫、深蓝色花纹靠垫、木桌，以及虚化的棕榈树与泳池。

人物与表情：
浅棕色头发在头顶随性盘起，留有空气刘海与垂至脸颊的碎发，明亮的浅褐色大眼睛，清晰眼线，淡粉色腮红，露齿微笑。面朝正面，直视镜头的明朗神情。

服装与姿势：
淡薰衣草紫与白色细竖条纹、带蕾丝与纽扣的细肩带抹胸上衣，同花色贴颈宽项圈，超短褪色牛仔短裤，肚脐钉，长款薰衣草紫美甲。双臂向前大幅伸展，双手比剪刀手。

背景与光影：
背景为带有深色木柱与横梁、中央白色布艺沙发、远处绿植与水池的通透休息室。左前方大开口透入柔和的日间自然光，前景双手高光明显，后方形成温和阴影。

构图与镜头：
3:4竖构图，胸部高度广角拍摄，容纳头顶至大腿上部。人物居中，透视放大双手置于前景，手部入镜完整。对焦面部兼顾双手，背景柔和虚化。

质感与风格：
写实摄影。高清呈现肤质、发丝、蕾丝纹理、牛仔布、美甲与木质面料质感，色调明快轻松。

负向提示：
改变双手V字手势与强烈透视感；改变服装颜色花纹
translations.en:
Theme:
Tropical Double Peace Signs

Subject:
In the center, a young woman extends both hands toward the camera making peace signs inside an open tropical resort lounge with wooden beams. In the background center are a beige sofa, white cushions, navy patterned cushions, a wooden table, and blurred palms and pool.

Person & Expression:
Light brown hair roughly tied high, thin bangs, loose strands, large bright hazel eyes, defined eyeliner, pale pink blush, vibrant smile showing teeth. Facing front looking directly at the camera.

Outfit & Pose:
Pale lavender and white thin vertical stripes bra top with lace, buttons, thin straps; matching wide choker, micro distressed denim shorts, navel piercing, long lavender nails. Arms reaching forward making V-signs.

Background & Light:
Open lounge with dark wooden pillars, white upholstered sofa, tropical greenery, and water. Soft daylight from a large front-left opening illuminating face/body with strong highlights on hands and gentle background shadows.

Composition & Camera:
3:4 vertical framing, chest-height wide-angle lens, top of head to upper thighs. Foreground hands emphasized by perspective. Face in focus, soft blurred background.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic photo with high detail on skin, hair strands, fabric, denim, nails, and wood textures, bright resort tones.

Negative:
Changes to double peace signs, changes to strong perspective, changes to outfit pattern/colors
